judge_precision._note: Precision of each judge's positive calls against Jacob's hand labels, for the precision-corrected rates in s1_analysis (spec D13 (d)): corrected rate = judge positive rate x n_hits/n, an estimate of the rate the judge detects (not the true rate, not a bound). Reported as an assumption-based sensitivity: the precision is transferred to calls and strata it was not measured on. Primary entry first; 'alternatives' are reported beside it.

invented.cards: 20-card claim page (draw fdafd0542d86d886): complete-history val2 claims pass 2 called unsupported that were not on the 60-card page; precision on the 14 still invented after the second look v2 (one 'can't tell' left out); a hit is Jacob labelling unsupported or contradicted
invented.note: 0.62 [0.36, 0.82], below D13's 0.7 floor: invention is exploratory (D14 (f)). The 6 claims the second look reversed were all labelled supported by Jacob (6/6). Pass-2 contradicted claims are not covered.

reloaded_excluded.cards: all 60 cards pooled, second look applied, item units with availability 'reloaded' excluded (other availability classes kept); hit = dropped or misstated

lost.cards: fresh page (draw c453e7c874c2380f), all 60 cards pooled, second look applied; item units whose row's availability is 'lost' (the headline's own class); a hit is Jacob labelling the item dropped or misstated
lost.measured_on: judge-dropped item cards only (the page sampled no judge-misstated calls)
lost.note: The gate first scored 'dropped' alone on the 35 held-out cards (8/13 = 0.62, below the 0.7 floor, reloaded items excluded). Counting 'dropped or misstated' (the analysis's LOST_GRADES) and restricting to availability 'lost' were decided after seeing the labels.

contradicted_unrechecked_descriptive.note: pass-2 contradicted, not re-checked by the second look, unvalidated; not in the invented rate
